findings.message: The source requires identity, RBAC, versioning, notifications, automation, and API integration, but the group has no concept candidates.
Cleaning and box rental may require separate concepts instead of one ancillary-service concept.
Resolve the verb-like and cross-language-sensitive term before KSML assembly.
The invoice may own the reference to the move rather than the move owning the invoice reference.
A time slot may not be known at initial booking.
Confirm whether the direct vehicle reference duplicates resource allocation.
